name: Sri Saralamma Gadde
significance: Goddess Saralamma is enshrined here throughout the year. On Day 1 of the Jathara, tribal pujaris perform secret rituals at Kannepally and carry Saralamma in a grand procession to Medaram Gaddelu. Services include Free Darshanam & Kumkuma Archana (Daily 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM).

name: Sri Pagididda Raju Shrine
location: Punugondla Village, Kothaguda Mandal, Mahabubabad District
significance: Enshrines the tribal chief and husband of Sammakka. His divine symbol is brought to Medaram on Day 1 by Koya priests. Services include Traditional Tribal Worship & Darshanam (Free).

name: Sri Govinda Raju Shrine
location: Kondayi Village, Eturnagaram Mandal, Mulugu District
significance: Enshrines the husband of Saralamma. His divine symbol is also brought in a procession to Medaram on Day 1. Services include Traditional Tribal Worship & Darshanam (Free).
